# Gx Protocol Analyzer Technical Specification

## 1. Executive Summary

The Gx Protocol Analyzer is a comprehensive tool for capturing, decoding, analyzing, and troubleshooting Diameter Gx interface traffic between PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function) and PCEF (Policy and Charging Enforcement Function) in LTE/IMS networks. This tool will provide deep packet inspection, protocol validation, performance metrics, and visualization capabilities for network engineers and developers working with policy control systems.

## 2. System Architecture

### 2.1 High-Level Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                     Gx Protocol Analyzer                     │
├───────────────┬────────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┤
│  Capture      │   Decoder      │  Analyzer   │     UI      │
│  Engine       │   Engine       │  Engine     │   Layer     │
├───────────────┼────────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────┤
│  - PCAP       │  - Diameter    │ - Statistics│ - Web GUI   │
│  - Live       │  - AVP Parser  │ - Filtering │ - REST API  │
│  - File       │  - Gx Specific │ - Alerts    │ - CLI       │
└───────────────┴────────────────┴─────────────┴─────────────┘
```

### 2.2 Component Design

#### 2.2.1 Capture Engine
- Support for live packet capture from network interfaces
- PCAP/PCAPNG file import and export
- BPF filtering for Diameter traffic (TCP/SCTP port 3868)
- Ring buffer implementation for continuous capture

#### 2.2.2 Decoder Engine
- Full Diameter base protocol (RFC 6733) implementation
- Gx specific AVP decoding (3GPP TS 29.212)
- Support for vendor-specific AVPs
- Message validation against specifications

#### 2.2.3 Analyzer Engine
- Session tracking and correlation
- Performance metrics calculation
- Protocol compliance validation
- Anomaly detection
- Statistical analysis

#### 2.2.4 UI Layer
- Web-based responsive interface
- Real-time packet display
- Search and filter capabilities
- Export functionality (CSV, JSON, PDF reports)

## 3. Functional Requirements

### 3.1 Core Features

#### 3.1.1 Packet Capture
- [ ] Live capture from network interfaces
- [ ] Import PCAP/PCAPNG files
- [ ] Capture filtering (BPF syntax)
- [ ] Automatic Diameter traffic detection

#### 3.1.2 Protocol Decoding
- [ ] Diameter header parsing
- [ ] Command Code interpretation (CCR, CCA, RAR, RAA, ASR, ASA)
- [ ] AVP decoding with proper data type handling
- [ ] Grouped AVP recursive parsing
- [ ] Vendor-specific AVP support

#### 3.1.3 Gx-Specific Analysis
- [ ] Session lifecycle tracking
- [ ] QoS parameter analysis
- [ ] Charging rule validation
- [ ] Usage monitoring tracking
- [ ] Event trigger detection

#### 3.1.4 Search and Filtering
- [ ] Filter by Session-Id
- [ ] Filter by IMSI/MSISDN
- [ ] Filter by Command Code
- [ ] Filter by Result-Code
- [ ] Time-based filtering
- [ ] Complex query builder

#### 3.1.5 Statistics and Metrics
- [ ] Message rate analysis
- [ ] Response time calculation
- [ ] Success/failure rate statistics
- [ ] Top talkers identification
- [ ] Bandwidth utilization

#### 3.1.6 Export and Reporting
- [ ] Export filtered packets to PCAP
- [ ] Generate PDF reports
- [ ] Export to CSV/JSON
- [ ] API for integration

## 4. Technical Specifications

### 4.1 Technology Stack

#### Backend
- **Language**: Python 3.10+
- **Framework**: FastAPI for REST API
- **Packet Capture**: Scapy, pyshark
- **Database**: SQLite for session storage, Redis for caching
- **Message Queue**: Redis Pub/Sub for real-time updates

#### Frontend
- **Framework**: React 18+ with TypeScript
- **UI Components**: Material-UI v5
- **State Management**: Redux Toolkit
- **Charts**: Chart.js / D3.js
- **WebSocket**: Socket.io for real-time updates

### 4.2 Data Models

#### 4.2.1 Diameter Message Model
```python
class DiameterMessage:
    version: int
    length: int
    flags: int
    command_code: int
    application_id: int
    hop_by_hop_id: int
    end_to_end_id: int
    avps: List[AVP]
    timestamp: datetime
    source_ip: str
    dest_ip: str
```

#### 4.2.2 AVP Model
```python
class AVP:
    code: int
    flags: int
    length: int
    vendor_id: Optional[int]
    data: bytes
    decoded_value: Any
    name: str
```

#### 4.2.3 Session Model
```python
class GxSession:
    session_id: str
    imsi: Optional[str]
    msisdn: Optional[str]
    state: str
    messages: List[DiameterMessage]
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime
    metrics: SessionMetrics
```

### 4.3 API Endpoints

```
POST   /api/capture/start          - Start packet capture
POST   /api/capture/stop           - Stop packet capture
POST   /api/capture/upload         - Upload PCAP file
GET    /api/messages               - Get decoded messages
GET    /api/messages/{id}          - Get specific message
GET    /api/sessions               - Get Gx sessions
GET    /api/sessions/{id}          - Get specific session
POST   /api/filter                 - Apply filters
GET    /api/statistics             - Get statistics
GET    /api/export                 - Export data
WS     /ws/realtime                - WebSocket for real-time updates
```

## 5. Implementation Plan

### Phase 1: Core Infrastructure (Week 1-2)
1. Setup project structure
2. Implement Diameter protocol decoder
3. Basic packet capture functionality
4. Database models and storage

### Phase 2: Gx Specific Features (Week 3-4)
1. Gx AVP dictionary implementation
2. Session tracking logic
3. Message correlation
4. Basic filtering capabilities

### Phase 3: Analysis Engine (Week 5-6)
1. Statistics calculation
2. Performance metrics
3. Anomaly detection
4. Alert system

### Phase 4: User Interface (Week 7-8)
1. Web UI implementation
2. Real-time updates
3. Search and filter interface
4. Visualization components

### Phase 5: Advanced Features (Week 9-10)
1. Export functionality
2. Report generation
3. REST API completion
4. Performance optimization

## 6. File Structure

```
gx-protocol-analyzer/
├── backend/
│   ├── app/
│   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   ├── main.py
│   │   ├── api/
│   │   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   │   ├── capture.py
│   │   │   ├── messages.py
│   │   │   ├── sessions.py
│   │   │   └── statistics.py
│   │   ├── core/
│   │   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   │   ├── config.py
│   │   │   ├── diameter.py
│   │   │   ├── gx_decoder.py
│   │   │   └── capture_engine.py
│   │   ├── models/
│   │   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   │   ├── diameter.py
│   │   │   └── session.py
│   │   ├── services/
│   │   │   ├── __init__.py
│   │   │   ├── analyzer.py
│   │   │   ├── filter.py
│   │   │   └── export.py
│   │   └── db/
│   │       ├── __init__.py
│   │       └── database.py
│   ├── requirements.txt
│   └── Dockerfile
├── frontend/
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── components/
│   │   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── services/
│   │   ├── store/
│   │   ├── types/
│   │   └── App.tsx
│   ├── package.json
│   └── Dockerfile
├── docker-compose.yml
├── README.md
└── LICENSE
```

## 7. Testing Strategy

### 7.1 Unit Tests
- Diameter message parsing
- AVP decoding
- Filter logic
- Statistics calculation

### 7.2 Integration Tests
- End-to-end packet capture and decode
- Session correlation
- API endpoint testing
- Database operations

### 7.3 Performance Tests
- High volume packet processing
- Memory usage optimization
- Response time benchmarks

## 8. Security Considerations

- Input validation for uploaded PCAP files
- Authentication for API access
- Secure storage of captured data
- Rate limiting for API endpoints
- Sanitization of user inputs in filters

## 9. Performance Requirements

- Handle 10,000+ messages per second
- Support PCAP files up to 10GB
- Real-time display with <100ms latency
- Support 100+ concurrent users
- Memory usage < 2GB for typical operation

## 10. Deliverables

1. Complete source code with documentation
2. Docker containers for easy deployment
3. User manual and API documentation
4. Sample PCAP files for testing
5. Performance benchmark report

---

This specification provides a comprehensive blueprint for building a production-ready Gx Protocol Analyzer with modern architecture and robust features.
